name: Classic Turtle Breakout — ES Futures
description: Classic Turtle Trading System on ES (S&P 500 E-mini) continuous futures. Long entry on 20-day Donchian upper breakout, short entry on 20-day Donchian lower breakout. Long exit on 10-day Donchian lower breakdown, short exit on 10-day Donchian upper breakout. ATR(20)-based Turtle sizing: risk 1% equity per trade, 2×ATR hard stop, contract multiplier=50. Rollover via LastTradingDay with 5-day offset, BackwardRatio adjustment.
source:
# =============================================================================
# Classic Turtle Breakout — ES Futures
# 20-day Donchian channel entry, 10-day Donchian channel exit
# ATR(20) Turtle sizing: 1% risk, 2×ATR stop, $50/point multiplier
# =============================================================================

# --- Data ---
src = study_assets()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LastTradingDay,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio,
    i_offset=5
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# --- Donchian Channels ---
# 20-period channel for entries
du_20, dl_20, dm_20 = donchian_channel(cont.h, cont.l, window=20)

# 10-period channel for exits
du_10, dl_10, dm_10 = donchian_channel(cont.h, cont.l, window=10)

# --- ATR for sizing and stops ---
atr_val = atr(cont.h, cont.l, cont.c, 20)

# --- Entry Signals (pulse: close breaks channel) ---
long_breakout = crossover(cont.c, du_20)
short_breakout = crossunder(cont.c, dl_20)

# --- Exit Signals (pulse: close breaks opposite channel) ---
long_exit = crossunder(cont.c, dl_10)
short_exit = crossover(cont.c, du_10)

# --- Persist entry state until exit fires ---
# hold_until: True from entry pulse until exit pulse
held_long = hold_until(long_breakout, long_exit or short_breakout)
held_short = hold_until(short_breakout, short_exit or long_breakout)

# --- Execution (wiring order: rollover → zone → sizing) ---

# 1. Rollover policy — tells engine which contract to trade
rollover_policy()(active=cont.s)

# 2. Entry/exit zone — both directions active
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long, short_entry=held_short)

# 3. Risk-based sizing: 1% equity risk, 2×ATR stop, ES multiplier = 50
#    risk_unit bundles the stop loss — no separate stop_loss needed
risk_unit(
    stop_unit=StopUnit.price,
    contract_multiplier=50
)(risk_pct=1, stop_distance=atr_val * 2)
